title: galium commune var. nouletianum
intro: Galium commune var. nouletianum, commonly known as Noulet's bedstraw, is a plant species within the Galium genus. As a medicinal plant, it has been used to treat various health issues, including its reported health benefits such as reducing inflammation and aiding in digestive problems due to its soothing properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions like menstrual cramps and other gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Galium commune var. nouletianum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
